title: Consolidation: Tone & Attitude in Words
goal: Combine evaluative suffixes, polite imperfect, *-ísimo*, *resultar*, *cuyo* and stance adverbs
grammar: sufijos-apreciativos, imperfecto-de-cortesia, superlatives, resultar-adjective, relative-clauses, stance-adverbs

items: I can use diminutives, augmentatives and pejoratives to signal warmth, admiration or disdain.
I can soften requests with the polite imperfect and intensify evaluations with *-ísimo* and *resultar*.
I can describe places with attitude using *cuyo*, *por/desde donde* and stance adverbs.
